canonical_condition: service=DATABASE AND environment IN {sandbox,development,staging} AND permission IN {read,read-only}
notes: Requires named system/resource scope, duration, reason, and verified Data/DBA authority.
Direct production data access or export is never an auto path.

canonical_condition: service=CLOUD_GPU AND environment IN {sandbox,development} AND quota_or_budget_status=verified AND privileged=false
notes: Requires provider, GPU type, quantity, duration, purpose, verified quota/budget, and verified approval.

canonical_condition: service=CLOUD_GPU AND (environment=production OR quota_change=true OR cloud_admin=true)
notes: Production, quota increase, or cloud-admin requests require reviewer.

canonical_condition: service=DEVICE_BOOT AND requested_action IN {boot_assistance,diagnosis,hardware_check} AND destructive_action=false
notes: Device wipe, firmware change, replacement, or conflicting evidence leaves the auto path.

canonical_condition: service=NETWORK_VPN AND requested_action=diagnose AND control_change=false AND public_exposure=false
notes: Requires target, symptom, source and environment; port is required only when applicable.

canonical_condition: service=NETWORK_VPN AND (control_change=true OR public_exposure=true OR firewall_change=true)
notes: Security owns risk decisions for inbound exposure, firewall, DNS/proxy changes and bypasses.

canonical_condition: service=ACCOUNT_ACCESS AND environment!=production AND access_type IN {read,standard,non_privileged}
notes: Requires verified system-owner approval that matches target system, access type and duration.
Ask for a least-privilege alternative; never auto approve.

canonical_condition: service=GIT_PERMISSION AND permission IN {read,triage,write} AND production_repository=false
notes: Requires verified repository-owner approval and a bounded duration.
Repository admin/maintain or production deployment scope requires reviewer.

canonical_condition: service=CI_CD AND environment IN {sandbox,development,staging} AND requested_action IN {view_logs,rerun,diagnose} AND control_change=false
notes: Credential, deployment, approval-gate, or config changes are not diagnostic-only.

scenario: Production or control-changing CI/CD and Kubernetes
canonical_condition: service IN {CI_CD,KUBERNETES} AND (environment=production OR privileged=true OR requested_action IN {deploy,manifest_change,permission_change,disable_gate})
notes: Reviewer confirms scope, rollback and authorized approval.

scenario: Non-production Kubernetes observation or bounded restart
canonical_condition: service=KUBERNETES AND environment IN {sandbox,development,staging} AND requested_action IN {view_logs,restart,scale} AND privileged=false
notes: Deployment, manifest change, destructive action and privileged exec are not auto paths.
Security cases always go to the security/reviewer flow.

canonical_condition: service=MONITORING AND requested_action IN {investigate,view_logs,view_metrics} AND control_change=false
notes: Production threshold, alert, routing, retention, or logging control changes require reviewer.
Do not auto approve threshold, notification or retention changes.
Requires verified license/budget owner for paid or capacity-bound requests.
Do not guess an owner. Preserve safe evidence and ask targeted questions.
